zero_activity_policy.rule: 200,000 enrollments with cq_active_event_any = 0 and CQ_label_final = warning are removed from the labelled population by a deterministic hash sample (sha256 of "20260917:" + enrollment_id, lowest 200,000 ranks); their label is set to NULL with cq_exclusion_reason = v3_sampled_zero_activity_warning_removal; every other zero-activity enrollment keeps its label
zero_activity_policy.to_confirm: that the split population 2,684,090 is counted after this removal; the report v1.8 population reconciliation must state the pre-removal count and this rule

LO.v3_1_change: same formula and bands as V3; courses without any observed attempt in every weighted assignment/exam component are excluded with reason no_scored_signal_in_course (102 courses, 172,003 enrollments) [V3.1 §4]

components.assignment_ratio_catalog: sum over catalog assignment problems of best automatic correct ratio (best score / full score over attempts) / catalog assignment problem count; unattempted = 0
components.exam_ratio_catalog: same rule over catalog exam problems; unattempted = 0
components.exam_problem_rule: exam problems = problems of the last hierarchical chapter when the course has exam_weight; every other problem is an assignment problem [LO §5]
components.weights: course_limit.csv (video, assignment, exam); weight total must equal 100

superseded_versions.reason: exam component unbounded (sum of correct ratios), score > 100 kept as E; 21,141 enrollments > 100 [LO §8]

prevalence_within_reachable_courses.reading: reachable-course shares are similar across slices (30-38% for >= 60), yet G within reachable courses is 47x lower in T2 than in T1: the T1 vs T2/T3 contrast is within-course temporal variation, not course composition; log coverage per slice (S0) remains the last alternative explanation to check

catalog_denominator_audit.active_problem_rule: catalog problem with >= 1 automatic-score event from any enrollment of the course; only components with positive weight enter the denominator
catalog_denominator_audit.conclusion: inflated catalogs do not explain the low ceilings for the bulk of courses (median active ratio 0.90 in the < 60 band); the mean of 0.74 shows a tail of courses with inactive catalog items, to be described, not corrected
catalog_denominator_audit.decision: keep catalog-normalised V3.1 as PRIMARY; active-catalog denominator not adopted; no V3.2
